title: Rat ACTB one-step RT-qPCR
author: Daniel Groelz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qrfdv3n

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Fixation
steps.instruction: Collect rat tissues (Liver, Kidney, Spleen, Intestine, Lung) no larger than 15 × 15 × 4 mm within 5 min of sacrifice.

substeps.instruction: For cryopreservation: Snap freeze in liquid nitrogen, transport on dry ice, and store at -80°C.
For NBF fixation: Submerge in neutral buffered formalin (Merck KGaA) at a ratio of at least 20:1 (v/v) for 24 hours at room temperature.
For PAXgene fixation: Fix in PAXgene Tissue Fix (PreAnalytiX Gmbh) for 2-4 hours at room temperature, then transfer to PAXgene Tissue Stabilizer for 24-72 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Tissue Processing and Embedding
steps.instruction: Process formalin or PAXgene fixed tissues using an automated tissue processor (TP1020 Leica-microsystems).

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 80%, 90%, 99% ethanol (2x), isopropanol (2x), and xylene (2x) for no longer than 1 hour at each position.
Infiltrate with Surgipath Paraplast-XTRA (Carl Roth GmbH) low-melting point paraffin by incubating 3 x 1 hour under vacuum at 56°C.
Embed samples within 30 minutes after infiltration.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA in triplicate from the respective tissue types and elute in 40µl of the specified solvent; store at -20°C.

substeps.instruction: Cryo: Use 10 mg of frozen tissue with RNeasy Mini kit (QIAGEN); elute in RNAse free water.
FFPE: Use three 10 µm thick sections with miRNeasy FFPE kit (QIAGEN); elute in RNAse free water.
PFPE: Use three 10 µm thick sections with PAXgene Tissue RNA kit (PreAnalytiX Gmbh); elute in Buffer TR4.

steps.title: RNA Quality Analysis
steps.instruction: Determine RNA yield, purity, and integrity.

substeps.instruction: Measure yield and purity via spectrophotometric absorbance at 260nm using a Nanodrop ND-1000.
Assess integrity via microcapillary electrophoresis on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with Agilent 2100 expert software.

steps.title: Primer Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare rat beta-actin (NC_005111) specific primers from lyophilized, HPLC-purified oligonucleotides (Metabion GmbH).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve oligonucleotides to a 100 µM stock solution.
Store stock solutions at -15°C to -30°C.
Prepare working solutions at 10µM.

steps.title: RT-qPCR Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25µl reaction mix using QuantiTect® SYBR Green RT-PCR (QIAGEN) in Rotorgene 72-Well Rotor Strip Tubes and Caps (0.1mL).

substeps.instruction: Add 10ng of total RNA.
Add 12.5µl 2x Quantitect SYBR Green Master Mix.
Add 1.25µl forward primer (10µM working solution, final concentration 0.5µM).
Add 1.25µl reverse primer (10µM working solution, final concentration 0.5µM).
Add 0.25µl RT Mix.
Adjust final volume to 25µl with water.

steps.title: Thermal Cycling and Amplification
steps.instruction: Run the reaction on a Rotor-Gene Q series II (QIAGEN) using Rotor Gene Q Series Software 2.3.1 according to the following stages:

substeps.instruction: Reverse Transcription: 50°C for 30 min (1x).
Hold Stage: 95°C for 15 min (1x).
PCR Stage (40x cycles): 94°C for 15 sec, 60°C for 30 sec, 70°C for 30 sec.
Melt Curve Stage: 95°C for 15 sec (1x), 60°C for 30 sec (1x), 95°C for 15 sec (1x).

steps.title: Validation and Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Validate the RT-qPCR results based on specificity and run validity.

substeps.instruction: Examine amplicon length via agarose gel electrophoresis.
Perform melting curve analysis to ensure no extraneous or non-specific peaks.
Verify no-template controls show no amplifiable product (no Ct).
Accept single reactions only if Ct < 40 and melting curves are valid.
